# Missing trigger or actor (REF003)

An instruction with no stated agent or trigger. In the spec pack this is an error.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `ref-missing-actor` |
| Family | referential |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | RE |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

A requirement with no agent, no condition, or neither. EARS templates exist to force both.

Bad:  The cache is cleared on startup.
Good: The boot script clears the cache on startup.

Not a finding when the actor and trigger are unambiguous in the surrounding section.

  hook_safe: false
